audit_items.proof_trace: Both `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89: `assert!(!self.debts.contains(CoinType))`) and `try_borrow_asset` (L121-124: `assert!(!self.ctokens.is_supporting_collateral())`) are context-independent guards that are the sole production paths for adding collateral or debt to an obligation. The flash loan mechanism operates exclusively on market reserves (`Reserve`/`ReserveFlashLoan`) with no interaction with obligation `debts` or `ctokens`, so user PTB steps during a flash loan callback cannot bypass these guards. All construction paths enforce mutual exclusion, and the proof survives stress-testing of each assumption.
